card.name: Bibliographic citation details before punctuation
card.fires_on: Marked spots inside reference lists and library catalog entries, such as a year digit, closing parenthesis after volume and issue, or a field label like Publication. It fires where a citation is about to continue with a period, comma or colon-like separator.

modes.label: Year and issue digits
modes.description: A digit or closing bracket within a year, volume or report number in a citation.
modes.example: Similar books and articles James Behuniak Jr (201<<1>>). Naturalizing Mencius. Philosophy

modes.label: Catalog field labels
modes.description: Words in catalog or repository metadata lines such as Publication, Added, or a bracketed online tag.
modes.example: Schaeffer, Gary A.; Reese, Clyde M.; Steffen, Manfred; McKinley, Robert L.; Mills, Craig N. -<< Publication>> Year: - Report Number: - Document

card.plain: It marks the small pieces of a scholarly reference, like year digits and catalog labels, where the entry is about to go on.
